mechanism_of_action: Non-steroidal farnesoid X receptor (FXR) agonist; FXR is described as a regulator of bile acid, glucose, and lipid homeostasis.
efficacy_outcome: After 4 weeks, ALT (p=0.027) and GGT (p=0.019) decreased, and insulin sensitivity improved in 92% of patients (p=0.02); hepatic steatosis measures did not change.
safety_signal: No serious adverse events; short intervals of cardiac arrhythmia in 2 patients led to study termination.
